scripts.test:e2e: set -a; source .env; set +a; npx playwright test
scripts.migrate: set -a; source .env; set +a; SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN=$SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN npx supabase db push --project-ref $SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
scripts.fn:deploy: set -a; source .env; set +a; SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN=$SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN npx supabase functions deploy server --project-ref $SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF --no-verify-jwt
scripts.fn:env: set -a; source .env; set +a; SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN=$SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN npx supabase secrets set --project-ref $SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF SUPABASE_URL=$VITE_SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=$SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY INVITE_REDIRECT_URL=$INVITE_REDIRECT_URL CORS_ORIGINS=$CORS_ORIGINS
